services.name: Fencing
services.description: A fence should stay straight, the gate should close without dragging, and it should still look good after a few Oregon winters.

services.name: Painting
services.description: Most paint failures start before the first coat goes on. We clean, sand, repair damaged areas, and prime everything first, because good prep is what keeps paint on the house.

services.name: Repairs
services.description: Small problems usually tell you about a bigger one. Fix them early and they're repairs. Wait too long and they become replacements.

services.name: Restoration
services.description: Bring worn surfaces back to life. We refinish fences, decks, and other woodwork to protect your investment and make your home look like new again.

services.name: Drywall
services.description: From small hole repairs to full installations, we handle drywall work that's smooth, seamless, and ready for paint.

services.name: Decks
services.description: A deck should become part of the way you use your home, not something that only looks good in listing photos.

services.name: Bathroom Remodeling
services.description: A bathroom should work every time, every day. We fix leaks, replace fixtures, and handle complete remodels.

services.name: Built-Ins & Finish Carpentry
services.description: The best built-ins don't draw attention to themselves. They look like they were part of the house from the beginning.

services.name: Historic Restoration
services.description: Old houses usually tell you how they were built. We pay attention before we start replacing things that don't need replacing.

services.name: Steel-Framed Covered Courtyards
services.description: Oregon weather doesn't stop because it's the weekend. A covered courtyard gives you an outdoor space you can actually use most of the year.

services.name: ADUs
services.description: Whether it's for family or rental income, an ADU has to fit the property before it fits the floor plan.

services.name: Pole Barns
services.description: Equipment, a workshop, livestock, storage — every pole barn starts with how you're actually going to use it.

services.name: Flooring
services.description: Good flooring starts underneath the flooring. If the subfloor isn't flat and solid, the finish floor won't stay that way either.
